1. Renew domain (needs your yes on the $14.99)
2. Publish the free Pagewell site now (no cost) — establishes web presence; custom domain/Pro can wait
3. Apply for Emberfall rapid grant ($5k–$25k, closes Nov 30) — draft a 2-page proposal
4. Bring Priya Raman (5 hrs/week data help) on board
5. Hold off on public-facing items (reporter quote, Corvid open letter, public comment) until you've cleared HR — you mentioned not wanting your name public yet

Everything else is on hold pending your input. Let me know about the domain and I'll proceed.

— Your AI agent

args.content:
# Halcyon Threshold — Emberfall Fund Rapid Grant Proposal

**Applicant:** Morgan Hale (individual, Halcyon Threshold)
**Round:** Emberfall Fund Rapid Grants (closes 30 November 2026)
**Amount requested:** $7,500
**Project duration:** 3 months (December 2026 – February 2027)
**Time commitment:** Evenings and weekends (~10 hrs/week)

---

## What we'll do

**Project:** Independent capability evaluations for a neglected frontier: long-horizon, multi-step planning in open-ended environments.

Most public evals focus on single-turn knowledge, coding, or reasoning benchmarks. Far less attention is paid to whether frontier models can reliably execute multi-day, multi-step plans with real-world constraints — a capability that matters most as models approach superintelligence. We will:

1. Build a small, transparent eval suite (Python) measuring multi-step planning reliability across a family of frontier models via API.
2. Run the eval across at least three frontier models (public API access).
3. Publish the results and the eval code under an open license on the Halcyon Threshold site, plus a short write-up for Alignment Commons.

This is deliberately modest and scoped to part-time, independent work. It does not require lab access, classified compute, or full-time staff.

---

## Why me / why Halcyon Threshold

- **Independent:** No affiliation with a frontier lab, avoiding conflicts of interest in evaluating those labs' models.
- **Technical enough:** Comfortable with Python and API-driven eval harnesses; not starting from zero.
- **Part-time but consistent:** Evenings and weekends for the next three months, with the capacity to ship a working eval suite and results.
- **Network:** Already in contact with independent researchers in the space (interpretability, governance, indie evals) who can review the design.

I have not gone public with Halcyon Threshold yet (pending an HR disclosure at my current employer), so this work would be attributable to the project, not to me personally, until I'm cleared.

---

## What it costs

| Item | Cost |
|------|------|
| Model API calls (3 frontier models, repeated runs) | $2,500 |
| Compute / cloud hosting for eval harness | $1,000 |
| Contractor: data analysis (Priya Raman, ~40 hrs at $40/hr) | $1,600 |
| Domain + minimal site hosting (halcyonthreshold.org) | $35 |
| Misc (reference materials, small compute overages) | $365 |
| **Total requested** | **$7,500** |

I am contributing up to $2,000 of my own savings this year toward Halcyon Threshold; this grant would cover the bulk of project-specific costs.

---

## Deliverables

1. Open-source eval code repository (MIT license).
2. Results briefing: model-by-model multi-step planning reliability.
3. Short write-up submitted to Alignment Commons.
4. Public (project-attributed) summary on halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.

---

**Contact:** morgan@halcyonthreshold.org

# Halcyon Threshold

Mission: contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

## Status (16 November 2026)

- **Site:** live on Pagewell free plan — https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app
- **Domain:** halcyonthreshold.org — renewal decision pending (expires 19 Nov 2026)
- **Grant application:** Emberfall Fund rapid grants, draft in `proposals/emberfall-rapid-grant.md` (due 30 Nov)
- **Help:** Priya Raman (data analyst, ~5 hrs/week) has offered to help
- **Budget:** up to $2,000/year of personal savings

## Not public yet

I work at Dorrance and my contract covers public statements and outside roles. I'm not putting my name on posts, letters, or press until I've spoken to HR (outside-activities disclosure due 30 Nov). Until then, Halcyon Threshold operates behind the scenes.

## Ideas (unsorted)

- Independent evals for something nobody is measuring
- A small-grants thing (if funding comes through)
- A reading group
- A newsletter (probably too many already)

The `old/` folder contains abandoned strategy drafts and is disregarded.

— M.
